name: Consulting

hero.k: Strategy should end in a choice.
hero.s: Behavioural consulting that turns insight into a prioritised growth plan.

pains.title: Too many priorities
pains.text: Every idea looks urgent, so nothing gets the focus it needs to work.

pains.title: Plans that ignore people
pains.text: Strategy assumes rational users. Real customers and teams decide differently.

pains.title: Insight stuck in slides
pains.text: Findings get presented, then filed. Nobody owns what changes next.

steps.text: What the numbers and people say.
Prioritise moves by impact and effort.
Agree the metrics that prove it worked.

views.text: Qual and quant research sizes each opportunity, so priorities rest on evidence, not opinion.
Positioning and narrative give every decision a story the whole organisation can repeat.

lens: Recommendations are framed with anchoring, framing and loss aversion in mind.

faq.question: How soon does behavioural consulting show results?
faq.answer: Strategy sprints run 4 to 6 weeks, with a prioritised roadmap at the end.

faq.question: Will you work with our leadership team?
faq.answer: Yes. We run workshops with decision makers, so every part of the plan has an owner before the work ends.

faq.question: What does a consulting scope look like?
faq.answer: One clear decision per phase, with outcomes agreed before we start. Each phase ends with a choice.

cta.p: A 15 minute fit call. We bring a first read of where your plan loses focus.
